title: 第248章 凰音独断万古李长生为复兴龙族而奋斗第247章 李长生的格局啊举世都是李家子弟
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 大秦仙朝的督战使，名为蒙战，大乘巅峰修为。
这是大秦仙朝皇室的标志。
蒙战坐在太师椅上，满脸不耐烦，声音冰冷：
蒙战一拍桌子，将茶盏震得粉碎，茶水四溅。
场面忽然变得紧张了起来。
惊蛰站在一旁，看着破碎的茶几，嘴角动了一下。
但随后又将这股杀意压制下去了。。
如果不是因为夫君有计划，早就一巴掌拍死这个不知天高地厚的家伙了。
“到时候如果再不见到人的话，产生了什么不可挽回的后果，可就怪不得我了。”
回头我得查一下他的祖宗十八代。
让其孤苦伶仃孑然一身过一辈子。
李长生牵着花清月的手，不紧不慢地走了进来。
御水和敖琉璃，则是落后半步，跟在他们身后。
目光扫视了一眼，前方破碎的茶几，皱了皱眉头。
然后目光落在蒙战身上。
content_en:

at the same time.
The guest reception hall of the Li family.
The war supervisor of the Great Qin Immortal Dynasty was named Meng Zhan, and he was at the peak of Mahayana cultivation.
Wearing black armor with gold patterns.
There is a black black bird embroidered on the chest.
This is the symbol of the royal family of the Great Qin Immortal Dynasty.
at this time.
Meng Zhan sat on the Taishi chair, his face full of impatience and his voice cold:
"The head of the Li family."
"Is the shelf this big?"
"You made me wait so long?"
"What does the Li family mean?"
Said.
Meng Zhan slapped the table, shattering the tea cup and causing tea to splash everywhere.
Break the skin.
The scene suddenly became tense.
Jingzhe stood aside, looking at the broken coffee table, and moved the corner of his mouth.
His face was cold.
A trace of killing intent arose.
But then he suppressed the murderous intention. .
If it weren't for my husband's plan, he would have slapped this ignorant guy to death long ago.
"Lord War Supervisor."
"Be patient and don't be impatient."
"The master of the house will be here soon."
Meng Zhan snorted coldly:
"My patience is limited."
"I'll give you another cup of tea."
"If I don't see anyone again by then, I won't be able to blame if there are any irreversible consequences."
Jingzhe: "..."
This man is so arrogant!
Coded.
I'll have to look up his ancestry back in the eighteenth generation.
Let him live his whole life alone.
…
Just then.
The door of the main hall was pushed open.
Li Changsheng held Hua Qingyue's hand and walked in slowly.
Yu Shui and Ao Liuli were half a step behind, following behind them.
After Li Changsheng walked in.
He glanced at the broken coffee table in front of him and frowned.
Then his eyes fell on Meng Zhan.
